manifest.selection_population: 7,343 users already materialized through validation for prior train-only Tiny/Pilot selection
manifest.selection_population_limitation: materialized union is train-only selected but partly enriched by the prior Tiny stratification; it is not a fresh scan of all 854,649 D_SID users
manifest.selected_user_rule: first 2,000 eligible users in seed-2026 stable hash order; eligibility is >=6 train-period groups
manifest.train_target_rule: all chronological train targets when <=64, otherwise 64 evenly spaced positions; feedback labels are never inspected
manifest.validation_target_rule: all chronological validation targets for the frozen selected users
manifest.validation_history: all groups strictly before target, including preceding validation groups
manifest.feature_definition: mean frozen SID semantics + feedback composition + log1p group size + log1p previous gap hours

baselines.definition: global prior uses the complete D_SID train split, never this Pilot subset

status.confirmation_scope: the fixed 2,000-user subset selected from the already materialized 7,343-user train-only pool
status.population_scope_limitation: the materialized pool is partly enriched by prior Tiny train stratification and is not a fresh random sample of all D_SID users
status.decision_rule: approve iff Full-history GRU validation CE is lower than previous-group composition and last-group MLP for every seed
status.stop_reason: Mark Generalization Confirmation Gate complete; Group-SNMPP was not implemented.
